text: In May 2022, Transportation Staff conducted a study to see if an all-way stop control at the intersection of McAdam Avenue and Groton Street met the criteria required for installation. This study came back finding that the criteria were not met. However, I have recently spoken to many members of the community who are concerned about the impacts of not having an all-way stop control at this intersection on community safety in the neighbourhood. The residents have polled neighbours and found overwhelming support for the installation of an all-way stop control at this intersection. Therefore, I am requesting that all-way stop controls be installed at the intersection of McAdam Avenue and Groton Street.
North York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way stop control at the intersection of McAdam Avenue and Groton Street.
